overall_summary: Core emotional relationship and self-respect content averages lower views (typically under 45 views), while family-oriented emotional hooks (Maa, Papa, Bhai) and universal life reassurance (Self Motivation, 'Call your loved ones') significantly outperform them, hitting 100 to 286 views.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about Maa (216 views), Papa (136 views), and calling a loved one (286 views) drastically outperform niche heartbreak/self-respect content.
winning_patterns.action: Pivot the core narrative slightly toward broader emotional life lessons and family relationships while retaining the diary/journal tone.

weak_patterns.pattern: Overly specific micro-digital actions for self-respect
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like un-pinning chats, removing emergency contacts, or deleting widgets got very low views (0 to 20 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid hyper-niche digital cleanup hooks as they suffer from diminishing returns and lower search/browse interest.
